9986-wild-kitty.title: Wild Kitty
9986-wild-kitty.creator: Unknown
9986-wild-kitty.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. But Judy had dodged her and was out of the room. Up to the attic flew the child, and after her dashed Bessie. The bag was found in the corner of the linen-cupboard. Bessie aimed a frenzied blow at Judy, who once again dodged her, then the schoolgirl ran downstairs and was out of the house.

arxiv-1711-03385.title: Match Made in Heaven: Practical Compressed Sensing and Network Coding for Intelligent Distributed Communication Networks
arxiv-1711-03385.creator: Maroua Taghouti, Anil Kumar Chorppath, Tobias Waurick and Frank H.P. Fitzek
arxiv-1711-03385.description: A 2017 arXiv research paper by Maroua Taghouti, Anil Kumar Chorppath, Tobias Waurick and Frank H.P. Fitzek. Based on the impressive features that network coding and compressed sensing paradigms have separately brought, the idea of bringing them together in practice will result in major improvements and influence in the upcoming 5G networks. In this context, this paper aims to evaluate the effectiveness of these key techniques in a cluster-based wireless sensor network, in the presence of temporal and spatial correlations.

arxiv-2012-10560.title: TOPCAT Visualisation over the Web
arxiv-2012-10560.creator: Mark Taylor
arxiv-2012-10560.description: Abstract The desktop GUI catalogue analysis tool TOPCAT, and its command-line counterpart STILTS, offer among other capabilities visual exploration of locally stored tables containing millions of rows or more. They offer many variations on the theme of scatter plots, density maps and histograms, which can be navigated interactively.

arxiv-2202-04014.title: Remarks on the cosmological constant appearing as an initial condition for Milne-like spacetimes
arxiv-2202-04014.creator: Eric Ling
arxiv-2202-04014.description: Abstract Milne-like spacetimes are a class of k = − 1 k=-1 FLRW spacetimes which admit continuous spacetime extensions through the big bang. In a previous paper [ 30 ] , it was shown that the cosmological constant appears as an initial condition for Milne-like spacetimes.

arxiv-2203-00473.title: Low-luminosity type IIP supernovae: SN 2005cs and SN 2020cxd as very low-energy iron core-collapse explosions 2022 Low-luminosity type IIP supernovae: SN 2005cs and SN 2020cxd as very low-energy iron core-collapse explosions – 16
arxiv-2203-00473.creator: Alexandra Kozyreva, Hans-Thomas Janka, Daniel Kresse, Stefan Taubenberger Petr Baklanov
arxiv-2203-00473.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Alexandra Kozyreva, Hans-Thomas Janka, Daniel Kresse, Stefan Taubenberger Petr Baklanov. SN 2020cxd is a representative of the family of low-energy, underluminous Type IIP supernovae (SNe), whose observations and analysis were recently reported by Yang et al. Here we re-evaluate the observational data for the diagnostic SN properties by employing the hydrodynamic explosion model of a 9 M ⊙ red supergiant progenitor with an iron core and a pre-collapse mass of 8.75 M ⊙ .

arxiv-2304-01825.title: Braid and Phantom
arxiv-2304-01825.creator: Jenia Tevelev
arxiv-2304-01825.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jenia Tevelev. Let N N be the moduli space of stable rank 2 2 vector bundles on a smooth projective curve of genus g ≥ 2 g\geq 2 with fixed odd determinant. In [ TT ] , we previously found a semi-orthogonal decomposition of the bounded derived category of N N into bounded derived categories of symmetric powers of the curve and, possibly, a phantom block.

arxiv-2308-15891.title: Understanding ProbLog as Probabilistic Argumentation
arxiv-2308-15891.creator: Francesca Toni Nico Potyka, Markus Ulbricht, Pietro Totis
arxiv-2308-15891.description: Abstract ProbLog is a popular probabilistic logic programming language/tool, widely used for applications requiring to deal with inherent uncertainties in structured domains. In this paper we study connections between ProbLog and a variant of another well-known formalism combining symbolic reasoning and reasoning under uncertainty, i.e. probabilistic argumentation.

arxiv-2312-03475.title: Molecule Joint Auto-Encoding: Trajectory Pretraining with 2D and 3D Diffusion
arxiv-2312-03475.creator: Weitao Du, Jiujiu Chen, Xuecang Zhang, Zhiming Ma, Shengchao Liu
arxiv-2312-03475.description: Abstract Recently, artificial intelligence for drug discovery has raised increasing interest in both machine learning and chemistry domains. The fundamental building block for drug discovery is molecule geometry and thus, the molecule’s geometrical representation is the main bottleneck to better utilize machine learning techniques for drug discovery. In this work, we propose a pretraining method for molecule joint auto-encoding (MoleculeJAE).

arxiv-2409-04297.title: Minimization of the Pseudospectral Abscissa of a Quadratic Matrix Polynomial
arxiv-2409-04297.creator: Volker Mehrmann, Emre Mengi
arxiv-2409-04297.description: Abstract For a quadratic matrix polynomial dependent on parameters and a given tolerance ϵ > 0 \epsilon>0 , the minimization of the ϵ \epsilon -pseudospectral abscissa over the set of permissible parameter values is discussed, with applications in damping optimization and brake squeal reductions in mind.

arxiv-2504-16647.title: Medium-induced coherent gluon radiation for 2 → 2 2\to 2 processes with general kinematics
arxiv-2504-16647.creator: \firstname Greg \lastname Jackson \fnsep, \firstname Stéphane \lastname Peigné \fnsep, \firstname Kazuhiro \lastname Watanabe \fnsep
arxiv-2504-16647.description: Abstract High-energy proton-nucleus (pA) collisions offer valuable insight into the role of cold nuclear matter effects in hadron production. In particular, multiple rescatterings of an incoming parton by the nuclear target are known to induce the radiation of many soft gluons.

arxiv-2505-07730.title: Reproducibility, Replicability, and Insights into Visual Document Retrieval with Late Interaction Conference: Proceedings of the 48th International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval; July 13–18, 2025; Padua, Italy Proceedings of the 48th International ACM SIGI
arxiv-2505-07730.creator: Jingfen Qiao, Jia-Huei Ju, Xinyu Ma, Evangelos Kanoulas, Andrew Yates
arxiv-2505-07730.description: Abstract . Visual Document Retrieval (VDR) is an emerging research area that focuses on encoding and retrieving document images directly, bypassing the dependence on Optical Character Recognition (OCR) for document search. A recent advance in VDR was introduced by ColPali, which significantly improved retrieval effectiveness through a late interaction mechanism.

arxiv-2510-16558.title: Toward Understanding Security Issues in the Model Context Protocol Ecosystem
arxiv-2510-16558.creator: Xiaofan Li, Xing Gao
arxiv-2510-16558.description: Abstract The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an emerging open standard that enables AI-powered applications to interact with external tools through structured metadata. A rapidly growing ecosystem has formed around MCP, including a wide range of MCP hosts (i.e., Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Desktop, and Cline), MCP registries (i.e., mcp.

arxiv-2512-19971.title: Intrinsic spin Nernst effect in spin-triplet superconductors
arxiv-2512-19971.creator: Taiki Matsushita ∗, Youichi Yanase, Takeshi Mizushima, Satoshi Fujimoto, Ilya Vekhter
arxiv-2512-19971.description: Abstract We theoretically investigate the intrinsic (impurity-independent) spin Nernst effect (SNE), a spin current generation perpendicular to temperature gradients, in spin-triplet superconductors. We show that, in these systems, the SNE consists of two distinct contributions: a direct quasiparticle contribution and an indirect supercurrent contribution. The quasiparticle contribution originates from the momentum space Berry curvature generated by spin-triplet Cooper pairs.

pmc-10610545.title: Preclinical Evaluation of an Imidazole-Linked Heterocycle for Alzheimer’s Disease
pmc-10610545.creator: Andrea Bagán, Sergio Rodriguez-Arévalo, Teresa Taboada-Jara, Christian Griñán-Ferré, Mercè Pallàs, Iria Brocos-Mosquera, Luis F Callado, José A Morales-García, Belén Pérez, Caridad Diaz, Rosario Fernández-Godino, Olga Genilloud, Milan Beljkas, Slavica Oljacic, Katarina Nikolic, Carmen Escolano, Xiao
pmc-10610545.description: Humanity is facing a vast prevalence of neurodegenerative diseases, with Alzheimer’s disease (AD) being the most dominant, without efficacious drugs, and with only a few therapeutic targets identified. In this scenario, we aim to find molecular entities that modulate imidazoline I2 receptors (I2-IRs) that have been pointed out as relevant targets in AD.

pmc-11712484.title: gamma‐secretase modulation: from bench to clinic
pmc-11712484.creator: Kevin Rynearson
pmc-11712484.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Cerebral beta‐amyloid accumulation is the key initiator of Alzheimer’s disease (AD) pathology. Most familial early‐onset AD mutations in the APP, PSEN1/2 genes increase the ratio of Abeta42:Abeta40, which drives beta‐amyloid accumulation in the brain. In 2001, the late Steve Wagner, Maria Kounnas, and I directed an agnostic high‐throughput screen for compounds that would reverse the Abeta42:Abeta40, ratio, and discovered the first non‐NSAID (second generation) gamma secretase modulators (GSM) at TorreyPines Therapeutics.

pmc-11862716.title: Facilitating effect of the hypnotically altered state of consciousness on decision-making in a situation modeling real-life
pmc-11862716.creator: Z. A. Kovács, S. László, A. Albert, Z. Janka, I. Szendi
pmc-11862716.description: IntroductionNumerous studies have shown a link between hypnotic susceptibility, the hypnotically altered state of consciousness, and the intensity of experienced emotions (De Pascalis et al., 1987; De Pascalis, Marucci, & Penna, 1989; Bryant & McConkey, 1989; Crowson, Conroy, & Chester, 1991; Crawford, Kapelis, & Harrison, 1995).

pmc-12410660.title: Effect of health promotion interventions in supermarkets on dietary variety among Japanese older adults: a protocol for a cluster non-randomised parallel-group comparative trial
pmc-12410660.creator: Tatsunosuke Gomi, Keiko Motokawa, Maki Shirobe, Masanori Iwasaki, Misato Hayakawa, Ayako Edahiro, Hirohiko Hirano
pmc-12410660.description: IntroductionWith an ageing population, prevention of frailty among older adults has become a critical public health issue. Dietary habits are one of the essential components in frailty prevention, which involves promoting changes in dietary behaviours, such as including dietary variety.

pmc-13058412.title: Tramadol for treatment of neurogenic cough: a retrospective case series
pmc-13058412.creator: Benjamin Joseph Rubinstein, Sheela Saidha, John Todd Sinacori
pmc-13058412.description: ObjectivesThis study aimed to explore the efficacy of tramadol for neurogenic cough and describe the longitudinal treatment experience.MethodsA retrospective case series of adults with chronic cough who were treated with tramadol for neurogenic cough. A complete response was defined as no pathologic coughing, and a partial response was defined as 50 per cent or greater reduction in severity or frequency.

pmc-13493563.title: Developing artificial intelligence-based techniques for brain MRI image segmentation
pmc-13493563.creator: Salliah Shafi, Gufran Ahmad Ansari
pmc-13493563.description: IntroductionBrain MRI image segmentation is essential for the accurate diagnosis and treatment of neurological disorders, including brain tumors, Alzheimer’s disease, and multiple sclerosis. Artificial intelligence (AI), particularly deep learning, has emerged as an effective approach for improving the precision and efficiency of medical image segmentation while reducing manual effort.

pmc-13509417.title: Incident Cognitive Impairment in Nonobese Versus Obese Adults Aged 50 Years or Older With Metabolic Dysfunction‐Associated Steatotic Liver Disease: A Propensity Score–Matched Cohort Study
pmc-13509417.creator: Akram Alnounou, Mohammad Alabbas, Riddhi Machchhar, EzzEIDien A Ibrahim, Mohammad Alali, Ahmad Alhusen, Syed-Mohammed Jafri, Basile Njei, Sreeja Dattachoudhury
pmc-13509417.description: AimsNonobese metabolic dysfunction‐associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) may carry disproportionate neurodegenerative risk, but whether body habitus modifies cognitive risk within MASLD remains unresolved. We compared cognitive impairment between nonobese and obese adults aged 50 years or older with MASLD.Methods and ResultsRetrospective cohort study with 1:1 propensity score matching in the TriNetX Research Network, a federated electronic health record network.

pmc-13635266.title: Mannan-oligosaccharides-based self-assembly nanoparticles enable gut-specific quercetin release, providing multi-pathway protection against AD via gut-brain axis
pmc-13635266.creator: Guifeng Zhang, Hongjiang Li, Wei Zhang, Dan Pu, Longxing Wang, Xiaofei Han, Ju Wu
pmc-13635266.description: Mannan-oligosaccharides (MOS), as indigestible functional prebiotic, support intestinal health. Here, we engineered MOS to undergo linoleic acid (LA)-mediated self-assembly with quercetin, forming lipid bilayer nanoparticles (MOS-LA/LA-Q NPs). These nanoparticles (NPs) achieved a high quercetin encapsulation efficiency (92.4%) and demonstrated superior stability in aqueous solution at 4 °C. The MOS outer layer effectively protected the quercetin core from gastrointestinal stress.

uslaw-usc-t26-s6110.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t26-s6110.description: United States Code, Title 26 (Internal Revenue Code); Chapter 61 (Information And Returns); Subchapter B (Miscellaneous Provisions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) General rule Except as otherwise provided in this section, the text of any written determination and any background file document relating to such written determination shall be open to public inspection at such place as the Secretary may by.
